about: Generated by node tools/records.js --sweep --json records/LOCATIONS.json, never edited by hand. For each of the records tools/records.js counts: where content for it exists outside the engine (repo, ref, path, record id inside the file), which of the fourteen components that copy holds in full or in part as the strict checker scores it, and the depth the record would reach if every copy were wired. Regenerate it after adding a location to tools/records-sources.json.

First generated 31 October 2026 against MOB origin/main d46be066. Locations are indexed here, not copied: most of them are generated scaffolding (the 33 saboteur and 108 fetter registries repeat one counterexample per category and one sentence pattern per field), and copying them into records/depth would plant wrong text in the canonical place.
